assignment_rule: Each card is independently implemented once by a natural LLM and once by a human. Cards describe task intent, never an expected safety verdict or defect.

cards.title: Left-arm payload cycle
cards.goal: Use the left arm to take responsibility for payload_alpha, perform a short processing pause, and finish with the payload released.
cards.freedom: Choose the legal API ordering and one allowed duration.

cards.title: Right-arm payload cycle
cards.goal: Use the right arm to take responsibility for payload_beta, perform a short processing pause, and finish with the payload released.
cards.freedom: Choose the legal API ordering and one allowed duration.

cards.title: Ready-dependent handler
cards.goal: When ready is true, let the left arm process payload_alpha; otherwise let the right arm process it. Each branch should complete a coherent payload cycle.
required_elements: both arm names across the two branches

cards.title: Mode-dependent processing plan
cards.goal: Implement two alternative processing plans selected by whether mode equals fast. Both plans should use one arm and terminate normally, but they may use different allowed durations or repetition.
required_elements: at least one timed operation in each branch
cards.freedom: Choose the arm and exact plan.

cards.title: Shared tool in two turns
cards.goal: Let both arms use tool_beta in two distinct turns, with a timed operation during each turn, and finish with the tool available.
cards.freedom: Choose which arm goes first and whether to express the turns sequentially or with synchronization.

cards.title: Fixture access selected by input
cards.goal: Use ready to choose which arm performs one fixture_alpha work cycle. The selected arm should perform a timed operation during the cycle.

cards.title: Parallel preparation rendezvous
cards.goal: Run one left-arm preparation lane and one right-arm preparation lane concurrently. Each lane performs a timed operation and both meet at one shared synchronization point.
cards.freedom: Choose durations and whether any work occurs after the rendezvous.

cards.title: Parallel approach and regroup
cards.goal: Move each arm along its matching approach trajectory in parallel, synchronize once, and then complete a short arm-local operation.

cards.title: Two-phase parallel job
cards.goal: Create two concurrent lanes with a preparation phase, a first rendezvous, a second work phase, and a final rendezvous.
required_elements: two matching barrier IDs in the same order

cards.title: Repeated fixture operation
cards.goal: Let one arm perform a fixture_alpha work cycle containing a literal bounded loop of repeated timed operations, then finish the cycle.
required_elements: for ... in range(2), range(3), or range(4)
cards.freedom: Choose the arm, loop bound and duration.

cards.title: Left-to-right payload handover
cards.goal: Implement a complete transfer of payload_alpha from the left arm to the right arm, ending with the sender no longer holding the payload.
cards.freedom: Choose durations and any synchronization structure needed by your implementation.

cards.title: Right-to-left payload handover
cards.goal: Implement a complete transfer of payload_beta from the right arm to the left arm, ending with the sender no longer holding the payload.
cards.freedom: Choose durations and any synchronization structure needed by your implementation.

cards.title: Conditional collaboration
cards.goal: When ready is true, perform a left-to-right transfer of payload_beta; otherwise complete a coherent single-arm payload_beta cycle.
required_elements: one collaborative branch and one single-arm branch
cards.freedom: Choose the single-arm side and durations.

cards.title: Two payloads, two arms
cards.goal: Have the left arm handle payload_alpha and the right arm handle payload_beta as part of one task. Both payload workflows must terminate.
cards.freedom: Choose sequential or parallel organization and allowed durations.

cards.title: Carrier and observer
cards.goal: While one arm performs a payload_alpha carry-related workflow, let the other arm perform timed observer work and synchronize the two lanes once.
cards.freedom: Choose which arm carries and the detailed operations.

cards.title: Carried payload with concurrent motion
cards.goal: One arm should hold payload_alpha while a parallel phase contains movement by both arms using their matching approach trajectories, followed by one rendezvous.
cards.freedom: Choose the carrying arm, durations and final payload operation.

cards.title: Tool-assisted payload workflow
cards.goal: Create one coherent task that uses tool_beta and also handles payload_beta. At least one timed operation must occur while the task is active.
cards.freedom: Choose arms, ordering, branching and whether concurrency is useful.

cards.title: Integrated bimanual workflow
cards.goal: Create a compact two-arm workflow that combines one shared resource, one payload, a parallel region and at least one synchronization point, then terminates.
cards.freedom: Choose all concrete identifiers, durations and operation order within the public language.
